rule.description: UniFi Controller: WiFi client $(unifi_client_alias) ($(unifi_client_mac)) connected to $(unifi_wifi_name) on $(unifi_ap_name) (rssi=$(unifi_wifi_rssi), auth=$(unifi_auth_method), ip=$(srcip)).
UniFi Controller: WiFi client $(unifi_client_alias) ($(unifi_client_mac)) disconnected from $(unifi_wifi_name) (duration=$(unifi_duration), last AP=$(unifi_last_ap_name), rssi=$(unifi_wifi_rssi)).
UniFi Controller: WiFi client $(unifi_client_alias) ($(unifi_client_mac)) roamed from $(unifi_last_ap_name) to $(unifi_ap_name) on $(unifi_wifi_name) (rssi=$(unifi_wifi_rssi)).
UniFi Controller: admin $(srcuser) accessed UniFi Network via $(unifi_access_method) from $(srcip) (site=$(unifi_site)).
UniFi Controller: client $(unifi_client_mac) ($(unifi_client_alias)) disconnected repeatedly - possible client flapping or RF/connectivity issue.
